build_AutoEncoder: build a hand mesh autoencoder with LBS pose, relighting decoder, and differentiable rendering
build_ConvTeacherDecoder: build a PBR hand decoder with GGX specular, shadow mapping, and UV displacement refinement
build_DisplacementUNet: build a U-Net that predicts mesh displacement and roughness from UV features and pose conditioning
build_FeatEncoderUNet: build a feature encoder U-Net that extracts gain and bias modulation from diffuse and specular features
build_URHandSummary: build a training progress image summarizer that grids rendered RGB, normals, and feature visualizations
